key.name: show-capture-overlay
key.summary: Open the SnipSnap all-monitor capture overlay
key.description: Keyboard accelerators which capture the GNOME stage and open the all-monitor region selector. Print is configured separately during a managed deployment so it does not conflict with GNOME's own binding.

key.name: external-annotator
key.summary: Hand committed captures to an external annotator
key.description: When enabled, the SnipSnap daemon opens committed captures in an external annotation program (satty) instead of its embedded region editor, so no daemon-owned editor window ever appears. The extension then commits without verifying an editor window. The activation manager keeps this key and the daemon's configuration in step; do not enable one side alone.
